subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class XII

source.read: CBSE curriculum 2025-26, English Core (301), Classes XI and XII: the Class XII course
source.note: Read through a text summary of the PDF, not the PDF itself. The board's prescribed chapters are named, not reproduced; the course is examined mainly through the textbooks, which are not in the app.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Reads a literary or factual passage and a case-based passage with data.
outcomes.note: Reading passages have questions; passages built on tables and charts are not yet in the app.

outcomes.text: Writes a notice of about fifty words.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.
